# send and acknowledgements

:::caution[v3 release candidate, unreleased]

This is the reference for `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk@3.0.0-rc.12`, generated from its source and spec. Names and shapes may still change before 3.0.0, and it is not on npm `latest`. For the released SDK see the [2.x reference](../../sdk/index.md).

:::

`send` is the one place a transaction leaves the SDK. It checks the chain, refuses a [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared) whose `warning` findings (or those of a simulation passed with it) are not acknowledged by code, sends `prepared.request` with the wallet and returns the hash at once, with `wait()` for the receipt (or, for a Safe, its execution). The helpers show the warnings and compute the codes; `findingsToAcknowledge` applies the same rule when your own wallet layer sends `request`.

## Pure helpers {#group-helpers}

### send {#send}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">wallet</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 6</span></div>

send (wallet): checks `prepared` and the wallet chain (PREPARED_INVALID,
CHAIN_MISMATCH, WALLET_REQUIRED), refuses a transaction with warnings the
caller did not acknowledge (FINDINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED, before the wallet is
asked for anything; see [`SendOptions`](./types/send.md#SendOptions)), sends `prepared.request` and returns as
soon as the wallet gives a hash (TX_REJECTED if it does not). `wait`
follows it: TX_REVERTED, TX_REPLACED (`cancelled` / `replaced`, with
`reason` and the `replacement` hash), TX_UNCONFIRMED. A `repriced`
replacement (a wallet speed-up) is reported through `onReplaced` and the
wait resolves with its receipt: re-key a stored hash there.

Sends `prepared.request` with the wallet. Refuses while a `warning` in
`prepared.checks` (or in `options.simulation`) is not listed in
`options.acknowledge`; see `send`.

```ts sdk-signature
obol.send(
  prepared: AnyPrepared,
  options?: SendOptions,
): Promise<Sent>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>prepared</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#AnyPrepared">AnyPrepared</a></span> |  |
| <code>options?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#SendOptions">SendOptions</a></span> |  |
| <code>options.acknowledge?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">readonly <a href="./types/send#FindingCode">FindingCode</a>[]</span> | The warning codes the caller has seen and accepts for this transaction (the meaning of each code is on the keys of `FINDINGS`). `send` refuses (FINDINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED) while `prepared.checks`, or the findings of `simulation`, hold a `warning` whose code is not listed. - `warningCodes(prepared, simulation)` gives exactly the codes this   transaction carries: pass it once those warnings have been shown to   whoever owns the funds. - A fixed list states a policy; a listed code with no matching warning   is ignored. - It is always a list of codes. There is no `true` or `'all'`: a value   that would also cover warnings nobody has seen is not accepted, and a   string that is not a finding code is PAYLOAD_INVALID (a typo must not   pass for an acknowledgement). - `info` findings never need one. For autocompletion of the codes one kind of transaction can carry, annotate with `FindingCodeFor<'withdraw'>[]`. |
| <code>options.simulation?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#SimulationForSend">SimulationForSend</a></span> | The [`experimental.simulate`](./experimental.md#simulate) result for this `prepared`. Its warnings (SIMULATION_REVERTED, SIMULATION_PREVIEW_MISMATCH, SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE, SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE, SIMULATION_UNTRUSTED_EVENT) then need acknowledging like the prepared ones. A simulation of another request is PAYLOAD_INVALID. |

</div>

**Example**

```ts
import { warningsOf, warningCodes } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

const distribution = await obol.ovm.prepareDistribute({ ovm: ovmAddress });
// Show warningsOf(distribution) first; acknowledge only what was shown and accepted.
const sent = await obol.send(distribution, { acknowledge: warningCodes(distribution) });
console.log(sent.hash); // keep it before waiting
const receipt = await sent.wait(); // TX_REVERTED, TX_REPLACED or TX_UNCONFIRMED otherwise
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: send</summary>

Tag: wallet. Inputs: [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared), `{ acknowledge: FindingCode[]?, simulation: Simulation? }`. Output: `{ hash:
Hash32, contractWallet: bool, wait(options?: { onReplaced?, timeoutMs?, confirmations? }) }`.

1. `prepared.request.chainId` equals the client chain and the wallet chain, else [`CHAIN_MISMATCH`](../errors.md#CHAIN_MISMATCH). The client's
   viem chain is passed to `sendTransaction`, so viem checks the wallet chain again when it sends; a wallet that
   switched in between is [`CHAIN_MISMATCH`](../errors.md#CHAIN_MISMATCH) too (nothing was sent). A context built by hand without `viemChain` uses a
   minimal viem chain with the client chain id. (send-time check new in 3.0.0-rc.5)
2. `kind` is one of the kinds of "Shared types", the `request` fields are well-formed (`to` an address, `data` hex,
   `value` ≥ 0) and `checks` is an array, else [`PREPARED_INVALID`](../errors.md#PREPARED_INVALID).
   (1. and 2. run first; then 2a, before the wallet is looked at, so a caller without a wallet can still learn what
   must be acknowledged.)

   2a. **Acknowledgement (3.0.0-rc.12).** Every finding with `severity: "warning"` in `prepared.checks`, and in
   `simulation.findings` when a simulation is passed, must have its `code` listed in `acknowledge`, else
   [`FINDINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED`](../errors.md#FINDINGS_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED) (`codes`: the distinct codes still open, in order; `findings`; a message naming each
   warning; a hint with the exact call, `send(prepared, { acknowledge: [...] })`, listing the codes already given
   plus the open ones). Nothing is sent and the wallet is not asked. Rules:
   - `acknowledge` is a list of finding codes. There is no boolean, wildcard or "all": `true`, a string or an object
     is [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID). An entry that is not a finding code (a typo, an error code) is [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID)
     (`issue: "unknown_finding_code"`).
   - A listed code with no matching warning is ignored, so a script can state a policy ("I accept
     [`SPLIT_REUSED`](../warnings.md#SPLIT_REUSED)-style conditions when they occur") without knowing whether it applies this time.
   - Acknowledging one code does not acknowledge another; one code covers every finding of that code on this
     transaction (several validators).
   - `info` findings never need acknowledgement.
   - `simulation` must be the `simulate` result of this `prepared` (its `request` equals `prepared.request`: `to`,
     `data`, `value`, `chainId`), else [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID) (`issue: "simulation_mismatch"`). Passing it is how
     "simulation was requested" reaches `send`: [`SIMULATION_REVERTED`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_REVERTED), [`SIMULATION_PREVIEW_MISMATCH`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_PREVIEW_MISMATCH),
     [`SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE), [`SIMULATION_UNTRUSTED_EVENT`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_UNTRUSTED_EVENT) and [`SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE) (could not simulate)
     then block until acknowledged.
   - An unknown options key is [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID) (`unknown_key`).

   Helpers (`pure`), so that the honest path is one line:
   - `warningsOf(prepared, simulation?)`: every `warning` of `prepared.checks` and of the simulation, in order, as
     findings (`code`, `message`, `hint`, `subject`, `details`): what a confirmation dialog, or an agent's report
     to its operator, shows.
   - `warningCodes(prepared, simulation?)`: their distinct codes, in the shape `acknowledge` takes.
     `send(prepared, { simulation, acknowledge: warningCodes(prepared, simulation) })` acknowledges exactly the
     warnings this transaction carries now, and nothing a later or different transaction might. It is computed from
     the transaction at hand, so it is not a blanket value; a caller that uses it without showing `warningsOf` to
     anyone has chosen to ignore the warnings.
   - `findingsToAcknowledge(prepared, { acknowledge?, simulation? })`: the warnings `send` would still refuse, for
     callers that send `prepared.request` through their own wallet layer (wagmi, a Safe app, a relayer): they send
     only when it is empty. `send` cannot enforce the rule on a caller that bypasses it.
   - `UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES`: the codes of the warnings that only mean "a check could not run"
     ([`DEPOSIT_EXISTENCE_UNCHECKED`](../warnings.md#DEPOSIT_EXISTENCE_UNCHECKED), [`VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED`](../warnings.md#VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED), [`PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN`](../errors.md#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN), [`SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE),
     [`SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE`](../warnings.md#SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE)), as a ready-made policy list. It never contains a warning about what the
     transaction does.

   Every helper refuses a `simulation` of another request ([`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID), `simulation_mismatch`).

   The codes are catalogued in `FINDINGS` (`src/findings.ts`): per code its `severity` (one per code, everywhere),
   `group` (`unchecked`, `risk`, `note`, `claim`), `meaning` and `guidance`; [`FindingCode`](./types/send.md#FindingCode) is the union of its keys.
   `FINDING_CODES_BY_KIND` lists the codes each [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared) kind can carry, and `Prepared<K>.checks` is typed to
   them (the compiler holds every `prepare*` to its list); `SIMULATION_FINDING_CODES` are the simulation's.

   The error is written to be acted on without other context: `message` has one numbered line per open warning
   (`code: message (hint)`), `details.findings` the same as objects, and `hint` says that nothing was sent, that
   the warnings go to whoever owns the funds (an agent reports to its operator and waits), the exact
   `send(prepared, { acknowledge: [...] })` call, and what to do if they are not accepted.

   The rule is the same for every `prepare*` (deposits, withdrawals, consolidations, OVM writes, splits, setup,
   incentive claims, direct EIP-7002 requests). The one prepare-time flag that remains is `acknowledgeFullExit`
   (`prepareWithdraw`, `prepareEoaWithdraw`), required only when an amount is 0.

3. The wallet rejects or fails before returning a hash: [`TX_REJECTED`](../errors.md#TX_REJECTED) (nothing was sent).
4. Returns as soon as the wallet returns a hash.

`wait` uses viem `waitForTransactionReceipt`; every error carries `hash`:

- receipt `status = 0` → [`TX_REVERTED`](../errors.md#TX_REVERTED) (nothing moved; retry is safe);
- replaced with viem reason `cancelled` or `replaced` (a different call was mined with the nonce) → [`TX_REPLACED`](../errors.md#TX_REPLACED)
  (details `reason` and `replacement`, its hash); `repriced` (same call, higher gas: a wallet speed-up) resolves with
  the replacement's receipt, reported through `onReplaced`: an app that stores the hash re-keys it to
  `replacement.transaction.hash` there;
- no receipt within `timeoutMs` → [`TX_UNCONFIRMED`](../errors.md#TX_UNCONFIRMED) (it may still be mined).

**Contract wallets.** A Safe connected over WalletConnect returns its `safeTxHash` from `sendTransaction`; that hash
never appears on-chain, and waiting for a receipt would time out silently. `send` therefore checks the wallet account
with `getCode`: non-empty code that is not an EIP-7702 delegation means a contract wallet, and the result has
`contractWallet: true`. For a contract wallet, `wait` does not look for a receipt of `hash`: it watches the account for
the Safe `ExecutionSuccess(bytes32 txHash, uint256 payment)` / `ExecutionFailure(bytes32 txHash, uint256 payment)` log
with `txHash = hash` (in the data for Safe 1.3.0, indexed as topic 1 for Safe 1.4.0 and later; logs are matched by
topic 0, which is the same for both), from the block `send` returned at, and resolves with the receipt of the
transaction that emitted it (`ExecutionFailure` → [`TX_REVERTED`](../errors.md#TX_REVERTED); nothing within `timeoutMs`, default 30 minutes for contract wallets →
[`TX_UNCONFIRMED`](../errors.md#TX_UNCONFIRMED) with `contractWallet: true`). A contract wallet that is not a Safe never emits these, so it ends in
[`TX_UNCONFIRMED`](../errors.md#TX_UNCONFIRMED); its app tracks execution itself. This is chain-only (no Safe Transaction Service) and is the only
Safe-specific code. (2.15 waited for `ExecutionSuccess` the same way)

`waitForContractWalletExecution({ publicClient, account, safeTxHash, fromBlock, timeoutMs })` (`chain`) exposes the
same rule for apps that send through their own wallet layer (wagmi) and only need the waiting part.

See [`lifecycles.md`](https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/lifecycles.md#transaction).

### warningsOf {#warningsOf}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span></div>

Every warning this transaction carries: the `severity: 'warning'` findings
of `prepared.checks` and, when given, of its `simulation`. What a
confirmation dialog (or an agent's report to its operator) shows: each has
a `code`, a `message`, usually a `hint`, and the validator or address it is
about in `subject`.

```ts sdk-signature
warningsOf<K extends PreparedKind>(
  prepared: Checked<K>,
): Array<Finding<WarningCodeFor<K>>>

warningsOf<K extends PreparedKind>(
  prepared: Checked<K>,
  simulation: SimulationForSend | undefined,
): Array<Finding<WarningCodeFor<K> | SimulationWarningCode>>
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>prepared</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Checked&lt;K&gt;</span> |  |
| <code>prepared.request</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreparedRequest">PreparedRequest</a></span> |  <span class="sdk-from">from <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a></span></span> |
| <code>prepared.checks</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Array&lt;<a href="./types/send#Finding">Finding</a>&lt;<a href="./types/send#FindingCodeFor">FindingCodeFor</a>&lt;K&gt;&gt;&gt;</span> | The findings of the checks, typed to the codes this kind can carry. A `warning` here stops `send` until its code is acknowledged (`warningCodes(prepared)`). <span class="sdk-from">from <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a></span></span> |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Array&lt;<a href="./types/send#Finding">Finding</a>&lt;<a href="./types/send#WarningCodeFor">WarningCodeFor</a>&lt;K&gt;&gt;&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { warningsOf } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

for (const w of warningsOf(tx, sim)) console.log(w.code, w.message, w.hint);
```

### warningCodes {#warningCodes}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span></div>

The distinct codes of the warnings this transaction carries right now
(`warningsOf(prepared, simulation).map(f => f.code)`, without repeats), in
the shape `send` takes:

  await obol.send(tx, { simulation: sim, acknowledge: warningCodes(tx, sim) });

Use it when those warnings were shown to whoever owns the funds and they
confirmed: it acknowledges exactly what this transaction carries and
nothing a later or different transaction might. Compute it from the same
`prepared` (and `simulation`) that were shown. Calling it without showing
anything is choosing to ignore the warnings; a script should name the
codes its policy accepts instead.

```ts sdk-signature
warningCodes<K extends PreparedKind>(
  prepared: Checked<K>,
): Array<WarningCodeFor<K>>

warningCodes<K extends PreparedKind>(
  prepared: Checked<K>,
  simulation: SimulationForSend | undefined,
): Array<WarningCodeFor<K> | SimulationWarningCode>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>prepared</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Checked&lt;K&gt;</span> |  |
| <code>prepared.request</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreparedRequest">PreparedRequest</a></span> |  <span class="sdk-from">from <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a></span></span> |
| <code>prepared.checks</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Array&lt;<a href="./types/send#Finding">Finding</a>&lt;<a href="./types/send#FindingCodeFor">FindingCodeFor</a>&lt;K&gt;&gt;&gt;</span> | The findings of the checks, typed to the codes this kind can carry. A `warning` here stops `send` until its code is acknowledged (`warningCodes(prepared)`). <span class="sdk-from">from <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a></span></span> |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Array&lt;<a href="./types/send#WarningCodeFor">WarningCodeFor</a>&lt;K&gt;&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { warningCodes } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

await obol.send(tx, { simulation: sim, acknowledge: warningCodes(tx, sim) }); // after showing them
```

```ts
import { findingsToAcknowledge, FINDINGS, type FindingCodeFor } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

// Sending tx.request with your own wallet layer (wagmi, a Safe app): same rule as send.
const policy: FindingCodeFor<'withdraw'>[] = ['VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED'];
const open = findingsToAcknowledge(tx, { acknowledge: policy });
if (open.length > 0) throw new Error(open.map(f => `${f.code}: ${FINDINGS[f.code].guidance}`).join('\n'));
```

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/send.ts#L376">source</a></p>

### isStale {#isStale}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span></div>

Whether `prepared` was checked more than `maxAgeBlocks` blocks before
`head` (a [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared) without `blockNumber` read no chain state and is never
stale). `send` never refuses an old one; an app that shows a review for a
while re-prepares when this is true.

```ts sdk-signature
isStale(
  prepared: Pick<AnyPrepared, 'blockNumber'>,
  head: bigint,
  maxAgeBlocks: bigint | number,
): boolean
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>prepared</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Pick&lt;<a href="./types/send#AnyPrepared">AnyPrepared</a>, 'blockNumber'&gt;</span> |  |
| <code>head</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> |  |
| <code>maxAgeBlocks</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint &#124; number</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { isStale } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

const head = await publicClient.getBlockNumber();
if (isStale(tx, head, 32)) console.log('prepare again before showing the review');
```

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/send.ts#L446">source</a></p>

### waitForContractWalletExecution {#waitForContractWalletExecution}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span></div>

Waits for a Safe to execute `safeTxHash`: the account's ExecutionSuccess /
ExecutionFailure log with that hash, from `fromBlock`. Chain-only.

```ts sdk-signature
waitForContractWalletExecution(__0: {
  publicClient: PublicClient;
  account: Address;
  safeTxHash: Hash;
  fromBlock: bigint;
  timeoutMs?: number;
  pollMs?: number;
}): Promise<TransactionReceipt>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>__0</code> | <span class="sdk-type">{ publicClient: PublicClient; account: Address; safeTxHash: Hash; fromBlock: bigint; timeoutMs?: number; pollMs?: number; }</span> |  |
| <code>__0.publicClient</code> | <span class="sdk-type">PublicClient</span> |  |
| <code>__0.account</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Address</span> |  |
| <code>__0.safeTxHash</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Hash</span> |  |
| <code>__0.fromBlock</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> |  |
| <code>__0.timeoutMs?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">number</span> |  |
| <code>__0.pollMs?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">number</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;TransactionReceipt&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { waitForContractWalletExecution } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

// What sent.wait() does for a Safe: follow ExecutionSuccess / ExecutionFailure for the safeTxHash.
const safeTxHash = '0x…' as `0x${string}`; // what the Safe returned
const executed = await waitForContractWalletExecution({
  publicClient,
  account, // the Safe
  safeTxHash,
  fromBlock: await publicClient.getBlockNumber(),
});
```

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/send.ts#L161">source</a></p>

## Constants {#group-constants}

### UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES {#UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span></div>

The warnings that only say "a check could not run" (group `unchecked`):
nothing is known to be wrong. For a script that states its policy up
front:

  await obol.send(tx, { acknowledge: UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES });

accepts every "could not check" warning and nothing else: a warning about
what the transaction does ([`TOP_UP_CREDENTIALS_FOREIGN`](../warnings.md#TOP_UP_CREDENTIALS_FOREIGN),
[`CONSOLIDATION_CREDENTIALS_DIFFER`](../warnings.md#CONSOLIDATION_CREDENTIALS_DIFFER), ...) is still refused. It is a list
like any other; read it before you use it.

```ts sdk-signature
UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES: readonly ["DEPOSIT_EXISTENCE_UNCHECKED", "VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED", "PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN", "SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE", "SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE"]
```

**Example**

```ts
import { UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

// Every warning that only means "a check could not run". Read the list before you use it.
await obol.send(tx, { acknowledge: UNCHECKED_WARNING_CODES });
```

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/findings.ts#L543">source</a></p>

### FINDINGS {#FINDINGS}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span></div>

Every finding code. Hover a key for its meaning; use the keys where a
[`FindingCode`](./types/send.md#FindingCode) is wanted (`acknowledge: ['VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED']`).

```ts sdk-signature
FINDINGS: { readonly DEPOSIT_EXISTENCE_UNCHECKED: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "unchecked"; readonly meaning: "No deposit status source: whether the validators already exist, and with which withdrawal credentials, was not checked."; readonly guidance: "Pass `beaconUrl` or enable the Obol API so it is checked. Acknowledge only after checking each pubkey yourself (a beacon explorer): a deposit to a validator someone else created first goes to their withdrawal address."; }; readonly DEPOSIT_ALREADY_QUEUED: { readonly severity: "info"; readonly group: "note"; readonly meaning: "Deposits with the same credentials are already queued for the pubkey."; readonly guidance: "Make sure this is not a repeat of a deposit already sent."; }; readonly QUEUED_CREDENTIALS_CONFLICT: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "Validly signed deposits queued for the pubkey carry different withdrawal credentials; the first one (yours) applies."; readonly guidance: "Find out who queued the other deposits. Acknowledge only if you accept adding ETH to a validator others have also deposited to."; }; readonly TOP_UP_ABOVE_EFFECTIVE_CAP: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "The deposit takes a 0x00 / 0x01 validator above 32 ETH; the excess is swept back to the withdrawal address, not staked."; readonly guidance: "Deposit at most up to 32 ETH, or switch the validator to 0x02 first. Acknowledge if the round trip of the excess is acceptable."; }; readonly TOP_UP_EXITED_VALIDATOR: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "Top-up to an exited validator: the ETH is swept back to its withdrawal address, not staked."; readonly guidance: "Do not top up an exited validator. Acknowledging sends ETH on a round trip to the withdrawal address."; }; readonly TOP_UP_CREDENTIALS_FOREIGN: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "Top-up to a validator whose withdrawal credentials are not the expected address's: the ETH can only be withdrawn to those credentials."; readonly guidance: "Acknowledge only for a deliberate top-up of a validator you do not control. The ETH cannot be recovered."; }; readonly OVM_STAKE_NOT_TRACKED: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "Deposit to an OVM's credentials through the batch contract: the OVM does not count it as principal, so it would later be paid out as rewards."; readonly guidance: "Deposit via the OVM instead. Acknowledge only if the owner will call `setAmountOfPrincipalStake` afterwards."; }; readonly PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "unchecked"; readonly meaning: "Could not check that the contract was created by the Obol OVM factory."; readonly guidance: "Retry `ovm.getProvenance`, or use an RPC that serves `eth_getLogs`. Acknowledge only if you know the contract by other means (you deployed it)."; }; readonly VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "unchecked"; readonly meaning: "The beacon chain request rules could not all be checked (`details.checks`); for a consolidation the withdrawal addresses were not compared."; readonly guidance: "Pass `beaconUrl` or enable the Obol API. Acknowledging accepts that the request may be ignored (fee lost) and, for a consolidation, that you checked the target's withdrawal address yourself."; }; readonly WITHDRAW_AMOUNT_CAPPED: { readonly severity: "info"; readonly group: "note"; readonly meaning: "The partial withdrawal amount was capped to what the validator can withdraw now."; readonly guidance: "None; the preview carries the capped amount."; }; readonly PARTIAL_WITHDRAWAL_QUEUE_FULL: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "The beacon chain's pending partial withdrawal queue is full: the request would be ignored and the fee kept."; readonly guidance: "Wait for the queue to drain. Acknowledging spends the fee for a request that is likely to be dropped."; }; readonly CONSOLIDATION_CREDENTIALS_DIFFER: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "Source and target validators have different withdrawal addresses: the stake moves out of this OVM and cannot be moved back."; readonly guidance: "Acknowledge only if the target validator and its withdrawal address (`details.targetWithdrawalAddress`) are yours."; }; readonly PRINCIPAL_STAKE_MISMATCH: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "The OVM's `amountOfPrincipalStake` differs from the principal on the beacon chain by more than 1 ETH."; readonly guidance: "Have the owner correct it with `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake` before distributing."; }; readonly PUBLIC_FORWARDER_HOLDS_ROLE: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "The owner or a role holder is a public forwarder: anyone can call the role-gated functions through it."; readonly guidance: "Revoke its roles, or transfer ownership away from it, now."; }; readonly ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "A change of owner does not revoke roles: the listed holders keep theirs."; readonly guidance: "Revoke the roles that should not survive, before or after. Acknowledge if the new owner knows the holders."; }; readonly ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED: { readonly severity: "info"; readonly group: "note"; readonly meaning: "Role holders could not be read, so surviving roles were not checked."; readonly guidance: "Check `ovm.getRoleHolders` afterwards."; }; readonly ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "Granting CONSOLIDATION: the holder can move the whole stake into a validator it controls."; readonly guidance: "Acknowledge only for an address you would trust with the stake."; }; readonly ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "Granting DEPOSIT to the principal recipient: it can raise the principal stake and take rewards as principal."; readonly guidance: "Grant DEPOSIT to another address. Acknowledge only if the reward recipients accept that."; }; readonly RECIPIENT_WITHDRAW_PAUSED: { readonly severity: "info"; readonly group: "note"; readonly meaning: "A recipient paused its Warehouse withdrawals; its withdrawal is left out of this transaction."; readonly guidance: "None; the recipient withdraws itself."; }; readonly RAF_LEFT_IN_WAREHOUSE: { readonly severity: "info"; readonly group: "note"; readonly meaning: "The Obol RAF balance stays in the Warehouse (it is not in the withdrawal set)."; readonly guidance: "None; anyone can withdraw it later."; }; readonly SPLIT_REUSED: { readonly severity: "info"; readonly group: "note"; readonly meaning: "The split already exists at the predicted address and is reused."; readonly guidance: "None."; }; readonly RECIPIENT_NOT_CONTRACT: { readonly severity: "info"; readonly group: "note"; readonly meaning: "An OVM recipient has no contract code (an EOA, or a split not created yet)."; readonly guidance: "If it should be a split, create it first or use `setup.prepareOvmWithSplits`."; }; readonly SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "unchecked"; readonly meaning: "The node could not simulate the request in full: only success or revert was checked, not what it moves."; readonly guidance: "Use an RPC with `eth_simulateV1`. Acknowledging sends on the strength of the preview alone."; }; readonly SIMULATION_REVERTED: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "The transaction reverts when simulated."; readonly guidance: "Do not send; prepare again, or fix the sender or state. Acknowledging sends a transaction expected to fail (gas lost)."; }; readonly SIMULATION_PREVIEW_MISMATCH: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "The simulation differs from the operation's preview."; readonly guidance: "Prepare again and simulate the new transaction. Acknowledging sends a transaction whose effect is not the one previewed."; }; readonly SIMULATION_READS_INCOMPLETE: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "unchecked"; readonly meaning: "Some balances or state could not be read while simulating: the changes shown are incomplete and not fully compared with the preview."; readonly guidance: "Simulate again, or on another RPC. Acknowledging sends without the full comparison; a missing change is not \"no change\"."; }; readonly SIMULATION_UNTRUSTED_EVENT: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "risk"; readonly meaning: "A contract with no known role in this transaction emitted events; they were not interpreted."; readonly guidance: "Look at the listed contracts. Acknowledge if they are expected (a recipient contract reacting to ETH)."; }; readonly SIMULATION_CONTRACT_WALLET: { readonly severity: "info"; readonly group: "note"; readonly meaning: "The sender is a contract wallet: its own signature and threshold checks were not simulated."; readonly guidance: "Check the transaction in the Safe app as well."; }; readonly NO_INCENTIVES: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "The address has no incentives to claim."; readonly guidance: "Nothing to do."; }; readonly INCENTIVES_NOT_FOUND: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "The Obol API has no incentives record for the address."; readonly guidance: "Check the address and the chain."; }; readonly INCENTIVES_FETCH_FAILED: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "The incentives record could not be fetched from the Obol API."; readonly guidance: "Retry later."; }; readonly OPERATOR_ADDRESS_MISMATCH: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "The incentives record is for another operator address."; readonly guidance: "Report it; do not claim."; }; readonly INCENTIVES_DATA_INVALID: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "The incentives record is malformed."; readonly guidance: "Report it; do not claim."; }; readonly CONTRACT_NOT_DEPLOYED: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "There is no contract at the distributor address."; readonly guidance: "Check the chain; do not claim."; }; readonly DISTRIBUTOR_UNKNOWN: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "The distributor contract does not have the expected code."; readonly guidance: "Do not claim; report it."; }; readonly UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "Incentives are not available on this chain."; readonly guidance: "Use mainnet or Hoodi."; }; readonly TOKEN_MISMATCH: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "The distributor pays a token other than OBOL."; readonly guidance: "Do not claim; report it."; }; readonly PROOF_INVALID: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "The Merkle proof does not verify against the on-chain root."; readonly guidance: "Do not claim; report it."; }; readonly ALREADY_CLAIMED: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "The incentives were already claimed."; readonly guidance: "Nothing to do."; }; readonly CLAIM_WINDOW_CLOSED: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "The claim window of the distributor has closed."; readonly guidance: "Nothing can be claimed from it any more."; }; readonly CHAIN_READ_FAILED: { readonly severity: "warning"; readonly group: "claim"; readonly meaning: "A chain read needed for a claim check failed."; readonly guidance: "Retry, or use another RPC."; }; }
```

**Example**

```ts
import { FINDINGS } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

const { severity, meaning, guidance } = FINDINGS.CONSOLIDATION_CREDENTIALS_DIFFER;
```

### FINDING_CODES_BY_KIND {#FINDING_CODES_BY_KIND}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span></div>

The finding codes each kind of prepared transaction can carry
(`Prepared<K>['checks'][number]['code']`). The compiler holds every
`prepare*` to its list.

```ts sdk-signature
FINDING_CODES_BY_KIND: { readonly deposit: readonly ["DEPOSIT_EXISTENCE_UNCHECKED", "DEPOSIT_ALREADY_QUEUED", "QUEUED_CREDENTIALS_CONFLICT", "TOP_UP_ABOVE_EFFECTIVE_CAP", "TOP_UP_EXITED_VALIDATOR", "TOP_UP_CREDENTIALS_FOREIGN", "OVM_STAKE_NOT_TRACKED"]; readonly withdraw: readonly ["PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN", "VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED", "WITHDRAW_AMOUNT_CAPPED", "PARTIAL_WITHDRAWAL_QUEUE_FULL"]; readonly consolidate: readonly ["PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN", "VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED", "CONSOLIDATION_CREDENTIALS_DIFFER"]; readonly distribute: readonly ["PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN"]; readonly distributeAll: readonly ["PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN", "RECIPIENT_WITHDRAW_PAUSED", "RAF_LEFT_IN_WAREHOUSE"]; readonly createOvm: readonly ["RECIPIENT_NOT_CONTRACT"]; readonly ovmWithSplits: readonly ["SPLIT_REUSED", "RECIPIENT_NOT_CONTRACT"]; readonly createSplit: readonly []; readonly claim: readonly []; readonly eoaWithdraw: readonly ["VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED", "WITHDRAW_AMOUNT_CAPPED", "PARTIAL_WITHDRAWAL_QUEUE_FULL"]; readonly role: readonly ["PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN", "ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION", "ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL"]; readonly ownership: readonly ["PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN", "ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER", "ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED"]; readonly recipient: readonly ["PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN"]; readonly principalStake: readonly ["PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN"]; readonly sweep: readonly ["PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN"]; readonly withdrawPullBalance: readonly ["PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN"]; readonly recoverFunds: readonly ["PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN"]; }
```
